intro.title: Built for clinical credibility, institutional strategy, and public-stage leadership.
intro.body: Mohamed Falfoul is a medical resident in child and adolescent psychiatry, strategy consultant, trainer, and youth advocate working across clinical settings, scientific dissemination, youth empowerment, organizational development, policy engagement, and civic participation.
proofPoints: Clinical residency in child and adolescent psychiatry across Tunisian university hospital settings.
Strategic advisory work with youth-centered institutions, ministries, NGOs, and international platforms.
1190+ hours of training delivered across leadership, advocacy, medical education, facilitation, mental health, and organizational development.
International representation and speaking across UN, UNESCO, TEDx, Education Above All, and youth policy platforms.

items.title: Child & Adolescent Psychiatry
items.audience: Hospital panels, academic boards, psychiatry programs
items.summary: Clinical training and academic engagement in child and adolescent psychiatry, spanning residency rotations, scientific posters, congresses, continuing medical education, and psychoeducational initiatives.
highlights: Resident at Fattouma Bourguiba University Hospital, Razi University Hospital, and Military Hospital clinical settings.
Scientific work on ADHD, ASD, child trauma, child victims of violence, parenting, and school identification.
Continuing medical education in ADHD, psychiatric emergencies, PACT, cybermobbing, bullying prevention, and therapeutic education.

items.title: Strategy & Organizational Development
items.summary: Strategic and organizational advisory work focused on youth empowerment, institutional development, policy support, governance, and systems strengthening.
highlights: Strategic development work with the Ministry of Youth and Sports in Tunisia.
Advisory and policy contributions through Education Above All, IFMSA, YOUTH CLUBs, and national task-force contexts.
Governance, training-system, curriculum, and youth-department structuring projects for mission-driven organizations.

items.title: Training & Capacity Building
items.audience: Corporate L&D teams, HR directors, INGOs, NGOs
items.summary: Design and delivery of training programs for youth leaders, students, educators, civil society actors, health-related stakeholders, and international student networks.
highlights: Training areas include leadership, facilitation, advocacy, civic engagement, organizational development, project design, mental health awareness, and soft skills.
Selected highlights include BLS for primary school teachers, advocacy campaigns for LMSA Libya, protection policies, medical education trainers, and ToT programs.

items.title: Leadership, Advocacy & International Representation
items.audience: Conference organizers, youth platforms, INGOs, policy forums
items.summary: Leadership and representation across youth-led organizations, international forums, policy-oriented platforms, and public speaking spaces.
highlights: Founder and founding president of YOUTH CLUBs Association.
Youth representative and speaker at the United Nations General Assembly.
TEDx speaker, UNESCO Transforming Education Summit participant, Education Above All workshop coordinator, and international youth forum representative.

items.title: UN General Assembly youth representative
items.description: Represented Tunisia alongside the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and delivered a speech on youth involvement in decision-making at UN Headquarters in New York.
